verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: a REST API, push notifications and watch channels for changes, and incremental sync. A developer could use these to build background automations, but the pack documents no product-provided way for a user to set up autonomous automations. Recurring events and auto-added invites are adjacent behaviors, not user-configured automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
